svg.title: The kit: machined plates dropped onto a table. Languages: Python, C++, C, CUDA, SQL. Infrastructure: Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, Docker, Linux, Git, PostgreSQL, FastAPI. Machine learning: PyTorch, PyTorch Geometric, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LangGraph, FAISS. Speaks: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, हिन्दी, English.
